## Summary

Describe what this pull request changes and why.

## Validation

- [ ] Root JavaScript files pass `node --check`.
- [ ] Relevant tests in `tests/` pass.
- [ ] Existing regression tests still pass.
- [ ] No inline CSS or inline JavaScript was introduced.
- [ ] No runtime CDN, analytics, telemetry or unexpected network dependency was introduced.
- [ ] User-controlled log content is rendered safely and not inserted as untrusted HTML.

## Product integrity

- [ ] Observed data is kept distinct from inferred/heuristic results.
- [ ] Missing trace/dependency information is reported honestly rather than invented.
- [ ] Local-first/privacy behavior remains accurate in documentation and UI copy.

## UI changes

If this changes the interface, describe desktop/mobile behavior and include a screenshot when useful.

## Notes for reviewers

Call out performance tradeoffs, storage-format changes, migrations, security implications or compatibility considerations here.
